name: ウォルマン病

summary.text: A severe form of lysosomal acid lipase deficiency characterized by rapidly progressive lipid accumulation in organs and tissues that presents in the neonatal or infantile period with massive hepatosplenomegaly, liver failure, diarrhea/steatorrhea and vomiting.
summary.evidence: A severe form of lysosomal acid lipase d

onset.text: in the neonatal or infantile period
